heard: Our God, our refuge and our strength, our help so near in need. We will not fear though earth gives way and mountains fall to sea. The waters roar and foam and rage, and hills shake at the swell. A river gladdens God's own town, where the Most High will dwell. The nations rage, the kingdoms fall, He lifts His voice, earth melts. Yet God is in her midst, she stands He helps her when day breaks The Lord of hosts is here with her
